corrections_to_prior_findings.claim: Qwen4ExpTextExperts is not recognized as a fused-expert module by llmcompressor
corrections_to_prior_findings.evidence: isinstance(instance, FusedExpertsProtocol) is True for a constructed module; the earlier false result came from probing an uninitialized instance created with __new__
transformers 5.17.0 ships transformers/models/qwen4_exp and exposes Qwen4ExpForCausalLM at the top level

corrections_to_prior_findings.claim: llmcompressor 0.14.0 can repack compressed MoE experts into the fused native layout
corrections_to_prior_findings.evidence: llmcompressor 0.14.0 and 0.14.0.1 only fuse weight_* qparams and cannot carry weight_packed; the compressed-expert repack exists only on upstream main

environment.note: llmcompressor 0.14.x pins transformers<=5.17.0, so this environment is already the newest compatible pairing

non_claims: The comparison proves layout equivalence of the quantized tensors only.
It does not prove that an inference engine can load or serve the fused artifact.
compressed-tensors 0.19.0 cannot decompress 3D fused packed tensors directly; verification therefore slices per expert.
fused_layout_workaround.reason: upstream main implements the compressed-expert repack but no released llmcompressor version carries it
fused_layout_workaround.semantics: gate and up are concatenated along the out-feature axis and stacked over experts, matching llmcompressor main src/llmcompressor/modeling/moe/pack_helpers.py

verification.comparison: MXFP4 decompression of both layouts through compressed-tensors, exact equality

non_claims: Every probe weight was randomly initialized; no checkpoint, corpus, or quality metric was involved.
No Flash-Next checkpoint was loaded and no GPU-hour of real quantization was spent.
A passing probe does not prove that a 231 GiB checkpoint fits in host RAM.
scope: Whether llmcompressor 0.14.0 can linearize, quantize, and repack Qwen4Exp MoE experts
